item.title: The One Band CHRIS CORNELL Believed Was America’s Answer To LED ZEPPELIN
item.description: Long before grunge made Seattle famous, Chris Cornell had already picked his local musical heroes. Among British rock influences, there was one American band he saw as a standout.

item.title: FOO FIGHTERS Release 'TODAY’S SONG' Ahead of Album’s 30th Anniversary; VIDEO
item.description: Foo Fighters have released a new track titled “Today’s Song” (watch below) to celebrate the upcoming 30th anniversary of their self-titled debut album. The single is available now on major streaming platforms.

item.title: Metallica Pays Tribute to Dedicated Fan Who Died During Edmonton Concert
item.description: Metallica paid a solemn tribute yesterday to one of their own— a dedicated fan, known as Lorne or simply “Viking,” who tragically passed away during their concert in Edmonton, Alberta.

item.title: Watch: Metallica Pays Tribute to Megaforce Founders with Old-School Set
item.description: Metallica recently gave fans a nostalgic kick in the gut with a special throwback show that would make any old-school fan tear up—if they’re still capable of crying, that is.
